newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Bus venture to build factories.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Bus venture to build factories.

text.p: Singapore Bus Service Ltd (SBS) said on Tuesday its wholly-owned subsidiary Waterbank Properties (S) Pte Ltd had entered into a joint venture agreement to build factories in western Singapore.

Under the joint venture with Technology Parks Pte Ltd and Lend Lease Asia Holdings Pte Ltd, the three companies would acquire a land parcel for Singapore $83.38 million from the Urban Redevelopment Authority, SBS said in a statement.
It said the joint venture partners would invest an estimated S$152 million to build terrace and semi-detached factories on the land.
Waterbank will hold a 25 percent stake in the joint venture company's issued share capital of S$8.0 million, with Technology Parks and Lend Lease taking up 40 percent and 35 percent respectively.
The statement said Waterbank's initial investment of S$2.0 million would be financed from internal resources.
